crossrefs.text: who wants everyone to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.
And love consists in this: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”
To all in Rome who are loved by God and called to be saints: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Little children, let us love not in word and speech, but in action and truth.
To Timothy, my true child in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
And the grace of our Lord overflowed to me, along with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
Since you have purified your souls by obedience to the truth so that you have a genuine love for your brothers, love one another deeply, from a pure heart.
For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments. And His commandments are not burdensome,
As for you, let what you have heard from the beginning remain in you. If it does, you will also remain in the Son and in the Father.
If you keep My commandments, you will remain in My love, just as I have kept My Fatherʼs commandments and remain in His love.
But if anyone keeps His word, the love of God has been truly perfected in him. By this we know that we are in Him:
If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.
You are My friends if you do what I command you.
For you, brothers, were called to freedom; but do not use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh. Rather, serve one another in love.
The entire law is fulfilled in a single decree: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”
“My teaching is not My own,” Jesus replied. “It comes from Him who sent Me.
If anyone desires to do His will, he will know whether My teaching is from God or whether I speak on My own.
So do not throw away your confidence; it holds a great reward.
Reject a divisive man after a first and second admonition,
If what he has built survives, he will receive a reward.
I am coming soon. Hold fast to what you have, so that no one will take your crown.
Now I urge you, brothers, to watch out for those who create divisions and obstacles that are contrary to the teaching you have learned. Turn away from them.
For such people are not serving our Lord Christ, but their own appetites. By smooth talk and flattery they deceive the hearts of the naive.
I still have much to tell you, but you cannot yet bear to hear it.
I speak with him face to face, clearly and not in riddles; he sees the form of the LORD. Why then were you unafraid to speak against My servant Moses?”
I have told you these things so that My joy may be in you and your joy may be complete.
Until now you have not asked for anything in My name. Ask and you will receive, so that your joy may be complete.
But now I am coming to You; and I am saying these things while I am in the world, so that they may have My joy fulfilled within them.
I hope to see you on my way to Spain. And after I have enjoyed your company for a while, you can equip me for my journey.

After I go through Macedonia, however, I will come to you; for I will be going through Macedonia. Perhaps I will stay with you awhile, or even spend the winter, so that you can help me on my journey, wherever I go. For I do not want to see you now only in passing; I hope to spend some time with you, if the Lord permits.
Recalling your tears, I long to see you so that I may be filled with joy.
